units.name: Pike Militia
units.description: Conscripts with ash-wood pikes and dented kettle helms; they set their pikes against horses.

units.name: Pike Veteran
units.description: Survivors of a dozen musters. Strike first when attacked in melee.

units.name: Longbowman
units.description: Yeomen archers in boiled leather, quivers of grey-fletched arrows.

units.name: Warbow Sergeant
units.description: Looses a hasty second arrow each turn (40% damage).

units.name: Shieldwarden
units.description: Tower-shield wall of scarred veterans; arrows rattle off, flankers find no gap.

units.name: Bulwark Sworn
units.description: Bangs shields and bellows challenges: enemy melee is drawn onto them.

units.name: Lancer
units.description: Heavy horse in blackened plate. Devastating on the first charge.

units.name: Oathbound Lancer
units.description: Lance-heads of cold iron: every hit strips 2 defense from the target (max 6).

units.name: Lightbearer
units.description: Lantern-priests who stitch wounds by candlelight and keep the line from breaking.

units.name: Dawn Confessor
units.description: Their litanies harden the whole army: +1 defense to every allied stack.

units.name: Sunhawk Rider
units.description: Knights on great bronze-feathered raptors, diving out of the blood-red sky.

units.name: Sunhawk Paladin
units.description: Strikes first, and each blow has a 20% chance to dazzle the target into losing its next action.

units.name: Bastion Colossus
units.description: A walking siege tower of riveted plate, crewed from within, older than the Concord itself.

units.name: Citadel Colossus
units.description: Draws enemy blows, retaliates against every attack, and its shadow gives the army +1 attack/+2 defense.

units.name: Iron Margrave
units.description: A scarred warlord-knight in black siege plate on a barded destrier the size of a bull; the Concord's last argument.

units.name: Iron Sovereign
units.description: Game changer: strikes first, every blow strips 4 defense (max 12), and riding at the head of the host gives every stack +2 attack.

units.name: Cinderling
units.description: Skittering, half-formed things of cracked slag. Cheap, quick and endless.

units.name: Seared Cinderling
units.description: Their touch keeps burning: 20% of damage dealt burns again next round.

units.name: Scorchhound
units.description: Skinless hounds with molten jaws, hunting in loping packs.

units.name: Hellmaw Hound
units.description: Two-headed: snaps a second time each attack (40% damage).

units.name: Brimstone Hurler
units.description: Hunched fiends lobbing balls of burning brimstone.

units.name: Brimstone Bombardier
units.description: Bursting shells: each shot also scorches a second enemy stack (30%).

units.name: Flayer
units.description: Hook-armed butchers; nothing they strike gets the chance to strike back.

units.name: Exalted Flayer
units.description: Drinks what it tears: heals 25% of damage dealt, even raising its fallen.

units.name: Ash Witch
units.description: Hags of the cinder pits whose hexes wither the enemy's arms.

units.name: Ash Matriarch
units.description: Her presence is dread itself: the enemy army suffers -1 morale.

units.name: Gorgewing
units.description: A bat-winged maw the size of a barn, all teeth and appetite.

units.name: Gorgewing Matron
units.description: Vomits fire over two stacks (40% to the second) and its shriek costs the enemy 1 morale.

units.name: Pyre Titan
units.description: A burning giant whose footsteps leave glass. Snow makes it hiss and slow.

units.name: Pyre Sovereign
units.description: The first time it is destroyed, half its number rise again from the ashes; its blows engulf a second stack.

units.name: Cinder Maw
units.description: A crawling furnace-mouth wider than a gatehouse, ringed with molten teeth; armies are fed to it.

units.name: Maw of Ruin
units.description: Game changer: swallows two stacks at once (60% to the second), heals 30% of what it devours and its presence costs the enemy 2 morale.

units.name: Shambler
units.description: Bloated corpses with too many teeth, dragged forward by something that is not hunger.

units.name: Rotting Shambler
units.description: Wounds it leaves fester: 20% of damage dealt rots again next round.

units.name: Marrow Archer
units.description: Skeletal bowmen strung with their own sinew; they never tire and never miss a cadence.

units.name: Marrow Deadeye
units.description: Bone arrowheads slip between plates: ignore 30% of the target's defense.

units.name: Gravecrawler
units.description: Low, many-jointed horrors that scuttle on hands sewn where feet should be.

units.name: Gravecrawler Brood
units.description: Paralytic bite: 15% chance per hit that the target loses its next action.

units.name: Wailing Shade
units.description: A grief that learned to fly. Blades pass through it one time in five.

units.name: Dirge Shade
units.description: Its dirge saps courage: the enemy army suffers -1 morale.

units.name: Corpse Weaver
units.description: Hunched surgeons of the dead who sew fallen undead back into the line.

units.name: Charnel Weaver
units.description: Puppeteers the dead: +1 initiative to every allied stack.

units.name: Gibbet Knight
units.description: A hanged knight still in his cage-armour, chains trailing like a cloak.

units.name: Gibbet Lord
units.description: Feeds on the living: heals 30% of damage dealt, raising its fallen.

units.name: Charnel Hulk
units.description: A mountain of stitched corpses that keeps knitting itself together.

units.name: Charnel Behemoth
units.description: Its flailing limbs strike two stacks at once (40% to the second).

units.name: Rotwing Leviathan
units.description: A carcass of something vast, held aloft on wings of flayed skin.

units.name: Rotwing Sovereign
units.description: Game changer: drains 40% of the damage it deals back into itself and its presence costs the enemy 2 morale.

units.name: Thorn Skulker
units.description: Gaunt, bark-skinned hunters with blowpipes; weak alone, deadly in numbers.

units.name: Thorn Stalker
units.description: Venom darts: 25% of damage dealt strikes again next round.

units.name: Barkhide Warden
units.description: Wardens whose skin has grown into armour; they hold the treeline for the archers.

units.name: Barkhide Sentinel
units.description: Sap-blood: the top creature recovers 6 hit points each round.

units.name: Briar Huntress
units.description: Hunters of the deep wood with horn bows and thorn-tipped arrows.

units.name: Briar Deadshot
units.description: Nocks two arrows at once (second at 50% damage).

units.name: Rootbinder
units.description: Druids who mend wounds with moss and sap and bind the earth to their will.

units.name: Rootbinder Elder
units.description: Roots rise around the army: +1 defense to every allied stack.

units.name: Gloomwing Strix
units.description: Silent owl-things with human faces that hunt by moonlight.

units.name: Gloomwing Shrike
units.description: Strikes first and slips 15% of blows.

units.name: Spore Lobber
units.description: Bloated fungal bearers hurling choking spore-sacs over the battle line.

units.name: Plague Lobber
units.description: The spores take root: 30% of damage dealt strikes again next round.

units.name: Rootbound Ancient
units.description: A walking oak, hollow and furious, that steps between its kin and harm.

units.name: Rootbound Patriarch
units.description: Lashes back at every attacker and regrows 50 hit points each round.

units.name: Wyrdthorn Mother
units.description: A towering hag-tree that flings thorn-volleys like hail.

units.name: Wyrdthorn Matriarch
units.description: Game changer: two volleys per turn (second at 70%), each with a 20% chance to pin the target in thorns (loses its next action).

units.name: Forge Thrall
units.description: Soot-black bondsmen in riveted aprons. Slow, stubborn, hard to kill.

units.name: Ironclad Thrall
units.description: Riveted plates turn arrows: -20% ranged damage taken.

units.name: Rivet Crossbowman
units.description: Squat crossbowmen with windlass bows that punch through mail.

units.name: Rivet Arbalist
units.description: Steel bolts: ignore 30% of the target's defense.

units.name: Anvil Guard
units.description: Hammer-and-slab warriors who fight like the forge itself.

units.name: Anvil Sworn
units.description: Hammer-back: retaliates against every attack each round.

units.name: Slag Golem
units.description: A smelter's mistake given legs: slow, heavy, glowing at the seams.

units.name: Furnace Golem
units.description: Roaring heat draws the enemy's blows onto it.

units.name: Cinder Engineer
units.description: Artificers with smoking toolkits who patch flesh and iron alike.

units.name: Master Engineer
units.description: Field-tunes every weapon: +1 attack to every allied stack.

units.name: Ironhoof Charger
units.description: Riders on clockwork boars that rumble out of the tunnels.

units.name: Ironhoof Warboar
units.description: Iron tusks crack armour: -3 defense on the target (max 9).

units.name: Thunder Bombard
units.description: A crewed black-powder bombard; every shot shakes the earth.

units.name: Doom Bombard
units.description: Shells stun: 25% chance per hit that the target loses its next action.

units.name: Molten Engine
units.description: A walking foundry with a furnace for a heart, crewed by the deep clans' best.

units.name: Worldforge Engine
units.description: Game changer: hammer-blows smash two stacks (60% to the second), strip 4 defense per hit and ignore 30% of armour.

units.name: Clan Raider
units.description: Fur-cloaked raiders with axes and round shields. Cheap and eager.

units.name: Blooded Raider
units.description: Gets angrier as the fight goes on: +4% damage per round (max +20%).

units.name: Rimefang Hound
units.description: Shaggy white war-dogs bred for the drifts.

units.name: Rimefang Packleader
units.description: Hunts like a pack: a second bite each attack (35% damage).

units.name: Oathless Berserker
units.description: Exiles who fight half-naked in the snow and feel nothing.

units.name: Bloodfrenzy Berserker
units.description: Blood-drunk: heals 20% of damage dealt.

units.name: Tusk Rider
units.description: Raiders on shaggy war-boars, crashing through shield walls.

units.name: Tusk Chieftain
units.description: Goring tusks: -2 defense on the target per hit (max 6).

units.name: Frost Shaman
units.description: Bone-masked shamans who call the cold into the enemy's limbs.

units.name: Storm Shaman
units.description: Hail-hexes: 15% stun per hit, and the gale at the army's back gives +1 initiative.

units.name: Rimeback Aurochs
units.description: Ice-crusted giant cattle ridden by the clans' bravest.

units.name: Rimeback Stampede
units.description: Tramples through: each attack also hits a second stack (40%).

units.name: Cairn Giant
units.description: Grey giants who sleep under burial cairns and wake hungry.

units.name: Cairn Warlord
units.description: Boulder-sweeps hit a second stack (30%) with a 20% chance to stun.

units.name: Winter Wyrm
units.description: A wingless ice-serpent that bores through glaciers and swallows war-bands whole.

units.name: Ancient Winter Wyrm
units.description: Game changer: freezing breath engulfs two stacks (60% to the second), 25% stun per hit, and its roar costs the enemy 1 morale.

units.name: Plague Rats
units.description: A carpet of diseased rats. Individually pathetic.

units.name: Dune Scuttler
units.description: Dog-sized beetles that burst from the sand.

units.name: Lost Pilgrims
units.description: Starving zealots wandering the roads with cudgels and prayers.

units.name: Moss Creeper
units.description: Crawling mats of moss that close their wounds as you watch.

units.name: Crag Slinger
units.description: Wiry hill-folk with slings, ambushing from the rocks.

units.name: Thornwolf
units.description: Wolves with bramble growing through their hides.

units.name: Road Cutthroat
units.description: Deserters and murderers who prey on caravans.

units.name: Carrion Flock
units.description: A storm of crows that peck the dying.

units.name: Corpse Light
units.description: Pale lights over the marsh that lure travellers into the mire.

units.name: Marsh Hag
units.description: Crone-things who curse from the reeds.

units.name: Sand Reaver
units.description: Veiled raiders on lean desert horses.

units.name: Rime Wight
units.description: Frozen dead that walk the passes, sucking warmth from the living.

units.name: Deserter Crossbows
units.description: Turncoat crossbowmen holding a ruined toll-keep.

units.name: Shrieking Harpy
units.description: Filthy winged scavengers that strike and are gone.

units.name: Tomb Scarabs
units.description: Black beetles that swarm from looted tombs.

units.name: Gloom Panther
units.description: Shadow-coloured cats that only show themselves to strike.

units.name: Bog Lurker
units.description: Armoured swamp-things that wait under the water for weeks.

units.name: Ashscale Basilisk
units.description: A grey lizard whose gaze stiffens muscle like ash.

units.name: Salt Witch
units.description: Hermit healers of the salt flats who travel with bandit bands.

units.name: Steppe Centaur
units.description: Horse-bodied archers who shoot just as well when cornered.

units.name: Cave Stalker
units.description: Blind ambush-hunters with hooked forelimbs.

units.name: Hill Troll
units.description: Warty brutes whose wounds close faster than you can cut.

units.name: Ogre Mauler
units.description: Gut-heavy ogres swinging tree-trunk clubs.

units.name: Ruin Sentinel
units.description: Stone guardians of a fallen empire, still obeying dead orders.

units.name: Cinder Wraith
units.description: Ghosts of the burned, trailing smoke and embers.

units.name: Barrow Revenant
units.description: An old king in rusted mail, guarding a barrow nobody remembers.

units.name: Venom Wyvern
units.description: Two-legged drakes with a stinger on the tail.

units.name: Frost Drake
units.description: Lean blue-white drakes that breathe sleet.

units.name: Bog Serpent
units.description: A coiled marsh-serpent that strikes at anything that comes close.

units.name: Dune Wurm
units.description: A sand-swimming worm the length of a caravan.

units.name: Hill Giant
units.description: Club-wielding giants that smash shields like crockery.

units.name: Primordial Wyrm
units.description: Something that was old when the mountains were young. Rarely seen; never forgotten.

units.name: Gloam Spear
units.desc: lean ash-grey elf in battered black lamellar, pointed steel helm, one long spear and small crescent shield

units.name: Dusk Sentinel
units.desc: lean ash-grey elf in battered black lamellar, pointed steel helm, one long spear and small crescent shield; upgraded with closed silver-edged plate and large hooked shield, longer serrated spear

units.name: Shardbow
units.desc: grim elf crossbowman in violet hood and black leather, compact two-handed crossbow

units.name: Venom Arbalist
units.desc: grim elf crossbowman in violet hood and black leather, compact two-handed crossbow; upgraded with armoured high-collared veteran with heavy recurved arbalest and small poison vial

units.name: Knifedancer
units.desc: athletic masked elf assassin in fitted black armour holding two curved daggers

units.name: Blood Scythe
units.desc: athletic masked elf assassin in fitted black armour holding two curved daggers; upgraded with severe silver death mask, layered spiked shoulder armour, two long sickle blades

units.name: Cave Lancer
units.desc: elf lancer astride a lean six-legged black cave lizard, violet saddlecloth

units.name: Dread Rider
units.desc: elf lancer astride a lean six-legged black cave lizard, violet saddlecloth; upgraded with heavily armoured lancer and silver-plated six-legged lizard with larger spined crest

units.name: Veil Adept
units.desc: severe grey-skinned elf sorceress in layered violet robes with single amethyst staff

units.name: Mirror Witch
units.desc: severe grey-skinned elf sorceress in layered violet robes with single amethyst staff; upgraded with tall silver headdress, floating intact mirror-shard halo joined to staff, deeper layered robes

units.name: Silk Stalker
units.desc: large threatening black cave spider with eight clearly separated legs, purple abdominal markings

units.name: Widow Matriarch
units.desc: large threatening black cave spider with eight clearly separated legs, purple abdominal markings; upgraded with massive black widow spider, silver carapace plates and enlarged violet-marked abdomen

units.name: Obsidian Guard
units.desc: towering elf executioner in broad black plate with a heavy two-handed axe

units.name: Onyx Executioner
units.desc: towering elf executioner in broad black plate with a heavy two-handed axe; upgraded with larger black-silver armour, high spined gorget, enormous crescent execution axe

units.name: Gloam Drake
units.desc: four-limbed black cave wyvern with two hind legs and two wing arms, folded violet membrane wings

units.name: Eclipse Dragon
units.desc: four-limbed black cave wyvern with two hind legs and two wing arms, folded violet membrane wings; upgraded with large regal obsidian wyvern, silver horn crown and sweeping violet membrane wings with luminous amethyst seams

units.name: Brine Spear
units.desc: lean gilled fish man with webbed feet, bone spear, small shell buckler

units.name: Reef Guard
units.desc: lean gilled fish man with webbed feet, bone spear, small shell buckler; upgraded with heavier ivory shell armour, coral-spiked crest, bronze trident and larger shell shield

units.name: Hookcaster
units.desc: hunched fish man holding a two-handed bronze harpoon launcher, spare barbed shafts on back

units.name: Abyss Harpooner
units.desc: hunched fish man holding a two-handed bronze harpoon launcher, spare barbed shafts on back; upgraded with larger eelbone launcher, deep-sea helm, multiple barbed shafts and bronze shoulder plates

units.name: Shellback
units.desc: stocky armoured fish man behind a huge weathered shell shield holding short cleaver

units.name: Barnacle Bulwark
units.desc: stocky armoured fish man behind a huge weathered shell shield holding short cleaver; upgraded with hulking barnacle-encrusted shell armour with enormous layered shell shield and bronze hooked blade

units.name: Mire Crab
units.desc: large low six-legged dark teal crab with two heavy front claws, coral shell nodules

units.name: Siege Carapace
units.desc: large low six-legged dark teal crab with two heavy front claws, coral shell nodules; upgraded with enormous crab with thick bronze-banded shell, serrated enlarged claws and shell siege spikes

units.name: Lantern Acolyte
units.desc: thin anglerfish humanoid in ragged teal robes, head lure and pearl-topped staff

units.name: Drowned Oracle
units.desc: thin anglerfish humanoid in ragged teal robes, head lure and pearl-topped staff; upgraded with tall abyssal priest with shell headdress, brighter head lure, ornate staff and heavy layered robes

units.name: Tide Mauler
units.desc: broad muscular shark-headed amphibious brute with scarred teal skin and two-handed anchor axe

units.name: Trench Reaver
units.desc: broad muscular shark-headed amphibious brute with scarred teal skin and two-handed anchor axe; upgraded with larger heavily scarred shark brute, bronze-and-shell shoulder armour and massive serrated anchor axe

units.name: Coil Serpent
units.desc: coiled amphibious sea serpent with two visible clawed forelimbs, dorsal fins and broad jaws

units.name: Storm Leviathan
units.desc: coiled amphibious sea serpent with two visible clawed forelimbs, dorsal fins and broad jaws; upgraded with massive royal coiled leviathan, ivory crown spines, armoured scale ridges and cyan-lit throat

units.name: Trench Titan
units.desc: towering bipedal deep-sea angler monster, two massive arms, lure, toothy jaws, coral back growths

units.name: Abyss Sovereign
units.desc: towering bipedal deep-sea angler monster, two massive arms, lure, toothy jaws, coral back growths; upgraded with colossal abyssal king with enormous shell crown, corroded bronze armour, stronger cyan lure and a huge coral-headed sceptre

units.name: Ancient Dragon
units.description: Karzhaloth, the eyeless dragon under the world, sealed behind the Nightgate. Interim: the primordial wyrm's poses recoloured to obsidian, ember and silver.

units.name: Pack Runner
units.description: A hired defender of the cobolt trading houses.

units.name: Caravan Spear
units.description: A hired defender of the cobolt trading houses.

units.name: Bolt Broker
units.description: A hired defender of the cobolt trading houses.

units.name: Cinder Alchemist
units.description: A hired defender of the cobolt trading houses.

units.name: Vault Warden
units.description: A hired defender of the cobolt trading houses.

units.name: Dreadmarshal
units.desc: armoured dark elf commander with glaive riding a lean six-legged black cave lizard

units.name: Veilseer
units.desc: hooded dark elf sorceress with violet staff riding a sleek black cave lizard

units.name: Nightstalker
units.desc: masked dark elf scout with compact crossbow riding a low six-legged cave lizard

units.name: Tidemarshal
units.desc: gilled fish man commander with coral trident riding a huge armoured six-legged shore crab

units.name: Deep Oracle
units.desc: robed anglerfish oracle with pearl staff riding a broad six-legged shore crab

units.name: Reef Hunter
units.desc: lean fish man harpoon scout riding a swift low six-legged shore crab
